info.name: MyPortfolio REST API (COMP229 Assignment 3)
info.description: Tests the API behind the React app: JWT sign-in/sign-out, protected routes and the two roles. Before running: start the server (npm run dev from /client) and create the admin account once with 'npm run seed:admin'. Run the folders in order (or use the Collection Runner). Admin-only requests use {{adminToken}}, normal-user requests use {{userToken}}; both are saved automatically by the sign-in requests.

exec: pm.test("welcome message", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Welcome to My Portfolio application."); });

item.name: 01 Authentication (JWT)
item.description: Run these in order. The no-token request is first on purpose: Postman keeps the httpOnly cookie 't' after sign-in and re-sends it, which would otherwise hide the 401.

item.name: POST register user (public) - role in body is ignored

exec: pm.test("a new account is always role \"user\"", function () { pm.expect(b.role).to.eql("user"); });
pm.test("the password is never returned", function () { pm.expect(b).to.not.have.property("password"); });
pm.test("a JWT token is returned", function () { pm.expect(b.token).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("the user object has the role \"user\"", function () { pm.expect(b.user.role).to.eql("user"); });

item.name: POST sign in with WRONG password (expect 401)

exec: pm.test("error message mentions \"don't match\"", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.include("don't match"); });

item.name: POST sign in as ADMIN (seeded account)

request.description: Run 'npm run seed:admin' once first so this account exists in MongoDB.

exec: pm.test("the user object has the role \"admin\"", function () { pm.expect(b.user.role).to.eql("admin"); });

item.name: 02 Roles - a normal user is blocked (expect 403)
